name: liberalize.kotlin.sdk.card.CardDetailsActivity
description: When an app asks a user to add a payment card, the Liberalize Frontend Android SDK opens this screen. The user enters the card number, holder name, expiry date, and security code; the SDK submits the card setup request and returns success or an error to the app.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing Liberalize card setup and returning the saved card result to the app.
